name: apyUSD
oneLiner: apyUSD is the ERC-4626 yield-bearing wrapper of apxUSD, capturing dividends and preferred-equity yield from Apyx's Digital Asset Treasury collateral.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: apyUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

collateral: apxUSD deposited into the Apyx ERC-4626 yield vault; apxUSD itself is backed by preferred equity shares from Digital Asset Treasury companies and liquidity buffers
pegMechanism: Users deposit apxUSD to mint apyUSD; cash dividends and preferred-equity yield accrue inside the vault, increasing apyUSD's exchange rate against apxUSD over time

mintAuthority.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over apxUSD. Wrapper minting creates apyUSD shares against deposited apxUSD, while durable base issuance is inherited from reviewed apxUSD issuer authority.

controls.label: apyUSD ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: The wrapper mints apyUSD shares through deposit/mint flows against apxUSD; it does not mint base apxUSD.
controls.evidence: Ethereum asset() returned apxUSD address 0x98A878b1Cd98131B271883B390f68D2c90674665 at block 25166610; totalAssets() was nonzero and paused() returned false.

controls.label: Inherited apxUSD signed-order mint authority
controls.evidence: apyUSD inherits the reviewed apxUSD mint-authority profile; Apyx contract documentation describes apxUSD minting through MinterV0 EIP-712 signed orders and AccessManager permissions.

review.evidence: Local variant metadata and Ethereum asset() reads confirm apyUSD is a wrapper over reviewed apxUSD rather than an independent base-dollar issuer. The inherited apxUSD mint path is signed-order MinterV0 issuance, not a plain issuer-backend mint.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve wrapper admin/owner roles if the detail view should show who can pause or upgrade apyUSD itself.
